title: No-render semantic adversarial audit of the immutable D12.11-I1 Material Index intervention
question: Does an independent validator reject 56 concrete, self-consistent or integrity-breaking mutations spanning the exact semantic attack classes preregistered by D12.11-I1, while reproducing the 15-to-0 alias endpoint from immutable raw payloads?
decisionRole: closes only the semantic mutation-coverage gap disclosed after D12.11-I1; it cannot alter Blender measurements, relax coverage, or convert the paired intervention into a fresh holdout

baselineValidator.independence: stdlib plus NumPy only; do not import the D12.11 analyzer, audit, consumers or Blender modules

families.mutation: flip one byte in each of eight bound parent artifacts
alter one R1/F0 source report without repairing its self-hash
flip one paired canonical adapter byte in each cell
replace critical Material Index owner arrays with Object Index and repair adapter self-hashes
zero, reuse, out-of-range and swapped declared tokens
change critical previous/current Object Index in each repeat and repair adapter self-hashes
set one registered H1 alias accepted in both consumer payloads and repair reports
set one H1-unaccepted coordinate accepted in each cell and repair dual reports
change one R1 fallback reconstructed byte per fixture in both consumers and repair reports
change one R1 reported coverage count per fixture and repair result evidence hash
promote result verdict and repair evidence hash
alter audit content and repair audit self-hash
alter receipt result verdict and repair receipt self-hash
raise one accepted critical risk value above threshold in both consumers and repair reports
negate one critical Vector X value and repair adapter report

attackRoster.passRule: Each attack operates on an isolated in-memory copy, the mutated state must fail every named expected gate, and the immutable formal root Git tree must be identical before and after all attacks. Hash-only nonce changes are forbidden.

requirements: This spec is committed and pushed before the new tool path exists.
The tool is committed and its Git blob equals its working bytes before execution.
The output root is absent before execution and created once.
No Blender process, render, model call or network call occurs.

decision.acceptedWhen: All 19 baseline gates pass, the raw 15-to-0 endpoint replays in both repeats, all 56 concrete attacks fail their named gates, the output is self-hashed, and the formal Git tree is unchanged.
decision.promotionEffect: An accepted result removes only the mutation-coverage promotion hold and accepts the bounded D12.11-I1 engineering conclusion: Material Index eliminated the registered owner aliases under this paired matrix, while H1 coverage remains unsupported.

nonClaims: This audit does not generate new Blender measurements or repair the frozen formal result in place.
It does not make the intervention an unseen-scene holdout or pass the unchanged coverage gate.
It does not validate multi-material owner propagation, shared-material duplication, transparency, deformation or production rendering.
It tests the declared validator boundaries and cannot prove the absence of every possible implementation defect.
